notes.title: Symphony Stride at Dreamhack ATL!
notes.notes:
Symphony Stride will be featured in the Dreamhack Atlanta Indie Playground on October 4-6, 2024!

notes.title: Symphony Stride Demo Now Available
notes.notes:
I'm excited to announce that the Symphony Stride Demo is now available! It includes the first chapter and two playable characters. If you find it enjoyable, don't forget to wishlist and leave a review!

Also, because I am poor and cannot afford a website, the presskit will be hosted here on Steam.
